one_liner: Aircall has a broad REST API with self-serve Basic Auth API keys for any customer account; OAuth is limited to approved tech partners; an official read-only beta MCP exists.
auth_notes: Basic Auth uses api_id:api_token generated in the dashboard (per-customer). OAuth 2.0 is for multi-customer apps but requires acceptance into the Tech Partner program for credentials.
access_notes: Any Aircall customer account can generate API keys. Aircall is a paid product, so a builder needs a trial or paid account. Evidence doesn't show a free tier. OAuth app credentials need tech partner approval. The Messaging API needs the Professional plan for direct access.
blocker_notes: Basic Auth keys work with an Aircall account, which probably needs a trial or paid plan. Multi-user OAuth needs Tech Partner approval, so a multi-tenant toolkit is gated by that program. Basic Auth per-customer keys are still workable for a toolkit.

evidence.quote: Aircall will generate two strings: an `API ID`and an `API token`, which act as your username and password.
Use OAuth when your app needs to access Aircall data on behalf of other users or customers.
OAuth credentials — If you haven't received them yet, apply to the [Tech Partner program]
A Private App is built for a single Aircall account. It's the fastest way to get started — no review process, no marketplace listing, and no OAuth flow required.
Direct API access requires the Professional plan.
Aircall Public API is a classic REST API. It can be used with any programming languages
We are also supporting **Webhooks**. We can call back any endpoint of your choice, each time an event occurs on an Aircall account
Aircall MCP gives your AI assistant access to search calls, transcripts, summaries, sentiment, topics, action items, evaluations, and predicted CSAT.
